# CG Showcase

> Cerys is a full-time UGC (user-generated content) Creator & Strategist based in North Wales / Manchester, UK, with over 10 years of combined experience in content creation and analysis. She creates realistic, aspirational UGC and content for product, hospitality and travel brands, working with brands both in the UK and internationally, and with digital and physical products.

## Pages

- [Portfolio](https://cgshowcase.co.uk/): Video and photo UGC examples across Product + Service UGC, Travel + Tourism / Hospitality, and Photography.
- [FAQ](https://cgshowcase.co.uk/faq.html): What UGC is, the formats and styles offered, package details, pricing approach, usage rights, and how to book.

## Services

- UGC video content for product and service brands, in these formats: Fun Edits, Lifestyle-Integrated (product reviews, day-in-the-life, trust-building narratives), Direct Response (demo/how-to, problem to solution, the upgrade), Couples content, and comedy Skits.
- UGC video content for hospitality and travel brands: dining and activities, and hotels.
- On-location brand photography.
- Works with brands based in the UK and internationally, and with both digital and physical products (physical products are shipped to Cerys for filming).

## Packages

- The Meta Ad Tester: 3 completed 9:16 videos, 30-day Meta Ads usage licence. For brands launching a new product or new to Meta ads.
- The Hook-Testing Matrix (most popular): 3 completed videos, 6 hooks (2 per video), 60-day Meta Ads usage licence. For performance marketers fighting creative fatigue.
- The Scaling Vault & Raw Asset Kit: 5 video assets, 15 hook versions, full access to raw unedited files with perpetual ownership, 90-day Meta Ads usage licence. For brands scaling a mature ad account.
